1.english_reference: He , that being often reproved hardeneth [ his ] neck

traditions.VUL: Viro , qui corripiéntem dura cervíce contémnit ,
traditions.KJV: He , that being often reproved hardeneth [ his ] neck ,
shall suddenly be destroyed ,
and that without remedy .

2.english_reference: When the righteous are in authority , the people rejoice

traditions.WLC: בִּ רְב֣וֹת צַ֭דִּיקִים יִשְׂמַ֣ח הָ עָ֑ם
traditions.KJV: When the righteous are in authority , the people rejoice :

2.english_reference: but when the wicked beareth rule , the people mourn

traditions.WLC: וּ בִ מְשֹׁ֥ל רָ֝שָׁ֗ע יֵאָ֥נַֽח עָֽם
traditions.VUL: cum ímpii súmpserint principátum , gemet pópulus .
traditions.KJV: but when the wicked beareth rule , the people mourn .

3.english_reference: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father

traditions.LXX: ἀνδρὸς φιλοῦντος σοφίαν εὐφραίνεται πατὴρ αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Vir , qui amat sapiéntiam , lætíficat patrem suum :
traditions.KJV: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father :

3.english_reference: but he that keepeth company with harlots spendeth [ his ] substance

traditions.WLC: ו וְ רֹעֶ֥ה ז֝וֹנ֗וֹת יְאַבֶּד הֽוֹן
traditions.LXX: ὃς δὲ ποιμαίνει πόρνας ἀπολεῖ πλοῦτον .
traditions.VUL: qui autem nutrit scorta , perdet substántiam .
traditions.KJV: but he that keepeth company with harlots spendeth [ his ] substance .

4.english_reference: The king by judgment establisheth the land

traditions.KJV: The king by judgment establisheth the land :

4.english_reference: but he that receiveth gifts overthroweth it

traditions.KJV: but he that receiveth gifts overthroweth it .

5.english_reference: A man that flattereth his neighbour spreadeth a net for his feet

traditions.WLC: גֶּ֭בֶר מַחֲלִ֣יק עַל רֵעֵ֑ הוּ רֶ֝֗שֶׁת פּוֹרֵ֥שׂ עַל פְּעָמָֽי ו
traditions.LXX: ὃς παρασκευάζεται ἐπὶ πρόσωπον τοῦ ἑαυτοῦ φίλου δίκτυον , περιβάλλει αὐτὸ τοῖς ἑαυτοῦ ποσίν .
traditions.VUL: Homo , qui blandis fictísque sermónibus lóquitur amíco suo , rete expándit gréssibus eius .
traditions.KJV: A man that flattereth his neighbour spreadeth a net for his feet .

6.english_reference: In the transgression of an evil man [ there is ] a snare

traditions.KJV: In the transgression of an evil man [ there is ] a snare :

6.english_reference: but the righteous doth sing and rejoice

traditions.LXX: δίκαιος δὲ ἐν χαρᾷ καὶ ἐν εὐφροσύνῃ ἔσται .
traditions.KJV: but the righteous doth sing and rejoice .

7.english_reference: The righteous considereth the cause of the poor

traditions.KJV: The righteous considereth the cause of the poor : [ but ]

7.english_reference: [ but ] the wicked regardeth not to know [ it ]

traditions.LXX: ὁ δὲ ἀσεβὴς οὐ νοεῖ γνῶσιν ,
traditions.KJV: the wicked regardeth not to know [ it ] .

traditions.LXX: καὶ πτωχῷ οὐχ ὑπάρχει νοῦς ἐπιγνώμων .

8.english_reference: Scornful men bring a city into a snare

traditions.KJV: Scornful men bring a city into a snare :

8.english_reference: but wise [ men ] turn away wrath

traditions.KJV: but wise [ men ] turn away wrath .

9.english_reference: [ If ] a wise man contendeth with a foolish man

traditions.WLC: אִֽישׁ חָכָ֗ם נִ֭שְׁפָּט אֶת אִ֣ישׁ אֱוִ֑יל
traditions.LXX: ἀνὴρ σοφὸς κρίνει ἔθνη , ἀνὴρ δὲ φαῦλος
traditions.VUL: Vir sápiens , si cum stulto conténderit ,
traditions.KJV: [ If ] a wise man contendeth with a foolish man ,
whether he rage or laugh , [ there is ]
no rest .
The bloodthirsty hate the upright :

10.english_reference: but the just seek his soul

traditions.LXX: οἱ δὲ εὐθεῖς ἐκζητήσουσιν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ .
traditions.KJV: but the just seek his soul .

11.english_reference: A fool uttereth all his mind

traditions.LXX: ὅλον τὸν θυμὸν αὐτοῦ ἐκφέρει ἄφρων ,
traditions.KJV: A fool uttereth all his mind :

11.english_reference: but a wise [ man ] keepeth it in till afterwards

traditions.WLC: וְ֝ חָכָ֗ם בְּ אָח֥וֹר יְשַׁבְּחֶֽ נָּה
traditions.VUL: sápiens differt , et resérvat in pósterum .
traditions.KJV: but a wise [ man ] keepeth it in till afterwards .

12.english_reference: If a ruler hearken to lies

traditions.VUL: Princeps , qui libénter audit verba mendácii ,
traditions.KJV: If a ruler hearken to lies ,
all his servants [ are ] wicked .

13.english_reference: The poor and the deceitful man meet together

traditions.KJV: The poor and the deceitful man meet together :

13.english_reference: the LORD lighteneth both their eyes

traditions.KJV: the LORD lighteneth both their eyes .

14.english_reference: The king that faithfully judgeth the poor

traditions.VUL: Rex , qui iúdicat in veritáte páuperes ,
traditions.KJV: The king that faithfully judgeth the poor ,

14.english_reference: his throne shall be established for ever

traditions.LXX: ὁ θρόνος αὐτοῦ εἰς μαρτύριον κατασταθήσεται .
traditions.KJV: his throne shall be established for ever .

15.english_reference: The rod and reproof give wisdom

traditions.KJV: The rod and reproof give wisdom :

15.english_reference: but a child left [ to himself ] bringeth his mother to shame

traditions.WLC: וְ נַ֥עַר מְ֝שֻׁלָּ֗ח מֵבִ֥ישׁ אִמּֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: παῖς δὲ πλανώμενος αἰσχύνει γονεῖς αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: puer autem , qui dimíttitur voluntáti suæ , confúndit matrem suam .
traditions.KJV: but a child left [ to himself ] bringeth his mother to shame .

16.english_reference: When the wicked are multiplied , transgression increaseth

traditions.LXX: πολλῶν ὄντων ἀσεβῶν πολλαὶ γίνονται ἁμαρτίαι ,
traditions.KJV: When the wicked are multiplied , transgression increaseth :

16.english_reference: but the righteous shall see their fall

traditions.WLC: וְ֝ צַדִּיקִ֗ים בְּֽ מַפַּלְתָּ֥ ם יִרְאֽוּ
traditions.LXX: οἱ δὲ δίκαιοι ἐκείνων πιπτόντων κατάφοβοι γίνονται .
traditions.KJV: but the righteous shall see their fall .

17.english_reference: Correct thy son , and he shall give thee rest

traditions.WLC: יַסֵּ֣ר בִּ֭נְ ךָ וִֽ ינִיחֶ֑ ךָ
traditions.LXX: παίδευε υἱόν σου καὶ ἀναπαύσει σε ,
traditions.VUL: Erudi fílium tuum , et refrigerábit te ,
traditions.KJV: Correct thy son , and he shall give thee rest ;

17.english_reference: yea , he shall give delight unto thy soul

traditions.WLC: וְ יִתֵּ֖ן מַעֲדַנִּ֣ים לְ נַפְשֶֽׁ ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ δώσει κόσμον τῇ ψυχῇ σου .
traditions.KJV: yea , he shall give delight unto thy soul .

18.english_reference: Where [ there is ] no vision , the people perish

traditions.LXX: οὐ μὴ ὑπάρξῃ ἐξηγητὴς ἔθνει παρανόμῳ ,
traditions.KJV: Where [ there is ] no vision , the people perish :

18.english_reference: but he that keepeth the law , happy [ is ] he

traditions.LXX: ὁ δὲ φυλάσσων τὸν νόμον μακαριστός .
traditions.VUL: qui vero custódit legem , beátus est .
traditions.KJV: but he that keepeth the law , happy [ is ] he .

19.english_reference: A servant will not be corrected by words

traditions.KJV: A servant will not be corrected by words :

19.english_reference: for though he understand he will not answer

traditions.LXX: ἐὰν γὰρ καὶ νοήσῃ , ἀλλ᾽ οὐχ ὑπακούσεται .
traditions.VUL: quia quod dicis intélligit , et respondére contémnit .
traditions.KJV: for though he understand he will not answer .

20.english_reference: Seest thou a man [ that is ] hasty in his words ?

traditions.LXX: ἐὰν ἴδῃς ἄνδρα ταχὺν ἐν λόγοις ,
traditions.KJV: Seest thou a man [ that is ] hasty in his words ? [ there is ]

20.english_reference: [ there is ] more hope of a fool than of him

traditions.WLC: ו תִּקְוָ֖ה לִ כְסִ֣יל מִמֶּֽ נּוּ
traditions.LXX: γίνωσκε ὅτι ἐλπίδα ἔχει μᾶλλον ἄφρων αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: stultítia magis speránda est , quam illíus corréptio .
traditions.KJV: more hope of a fool than of him .

21.english_reference: He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child

traditions.LXX: ὃς κατασπαταλᾷ ἐκ παιδὸς οἰκέτης ἔσται ,
traditions.VUL: Qui delicáte a puerítia nutrit servum suum ,
traditions.KJV: He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child

21.english_reference: shall have him become [ his ] son at the length

traditions.KJV: shall have him become [ his ] son at the length .

22.english_reference: An angry man stirreth up strife

traditions.KJV: An angry man stirreth up strife ,

22.english_reference: and a furious man aboundeth in transgression

traditions.VUL: et qui ad indignándum fácilis est , erit ad peccándum proclívior .
traditions.KJV: and a furious man aboundeth in transgression .

23.english_reference: A man ’s pride shall bring him low

traditions.KJV: A man ’s pride shall bring him low :

23.english_reference: but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit

traditions.LXX: τοὺς δὲ ταπεινόφρονας ἐρείδει δόξῃ Κύριος .
traditions.KJV: but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit .

24.english_reference: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul

traditions.WLC: חוֹלֵ֣ק עִם גַּ֭נָּב שׂוֹנֵ֣א נַפְשׁ֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: ὃς μερίζεται κλέπτῃ , μισεῖ τὴν ἑαυτοῦ ψυχήν ·
traditions.VUL: Qui cum fure partícipat , odit ánimam suam :
traditions.KJV: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul :

24.english_reference: he heareth cursing, and bewrayeth [ it ] not

traditions.LXX: ἐὰν δὲ ὅρκου προτεθέντος ἀκούσαντες μὴ ἀναγγείλωσιν ,
traditions.KJV: he heareth cursing , and bewrayeth [ it ] not .

25.english_reference: The fear of man bringeth a snare :

traditions.KJV: The fear of man bringeth a snare :

25.english_reference: but whoso putteth his trust in the LORD shall be safe .

traditions.LXX: ὁ δὲ πεποιθὼς ἐπὶ Κυρίῳ εὐφρανθήσεται . ἀσέβεια ἀνδρὶ δίδωσιν σφάλμα , ὃς δὲ πέποιθεν ἐπὶ τῷ δεσπότῃ σωθήσεται .
traditions.KJV: but whoso putteth his trust in the LORD shall be safe .
Many seek the ruler ’s favour ;

26.english_reference: but [ every ] man ’s judgment [ cometh ] from the LORD

traditions.LXX: παρὰ δὲ Κυρίου γίνεται τὸ δίκαιον ἀνδρί .
traditions.VUL: et iudícium a Dómino egréditur singulórum .
traditions.KJV: but [ every ] man ’s judgment [ cometh ] from the LORD .

27.english_reference: An unjust man [ is ] an abomination to the just

traditions.KJV: An unjust man [ is ] an abomination to the just :

27.english_reference: and [ he that is ] upright in the way [ is ] abomination to the wicked

traditions.VUL: et abominántur ímpii eos , qui in recta sunt via .
traditions.KJV: and [ he that is ] upright in the way [ is ] abomination to the wicked .

traditions.VUL: Verbum custódiens fílius , extra perditiónem erit .
